subject: EU embeddings: elevated p95 and partial routing — customer notice & follow-up
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@northwave.ai>
To: support@redwood.com
Cc: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-01T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sudden p95 increase for embeddings (EU) — urgent

Hi team,

We're seeing a sharp increase in p95 latency for our embeddings calls served from eu-west (up from ~120ms to ~1.1s) starting 08:00 UTC. This started shortly after our pipeline began a bulk job but the requests are individual embed calls at normal QPS. Can you confirm if there are known changes to routing or kernels in the EU region? The degraded tail is causing timeouts in our ingestion pipeline.

Stack: API /v1/embeddings (model: embed-light-v1), region: eu-west-1, sample request ids: rw-req-7a2, rw-req-7a3.

We appreciate a quick acknowledgment and any mitigation steps.

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Data Engineering
Northwave AI

--
Attachment: sample-call.json (application/json)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@northwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, support@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-01T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden p95 increase for embeddings (EU) — urgent

Hi Elena — thanks for the report and the sample ids. We see elevated tail latencies in eu-west for embedding generation starting ~07:50 UTC. I'm opening an incident and routing this to our on-call infra + account team.

Immediate mitigation we are trying: 1) apply targeted routing change to route Northwave's traffic to a healthy pool; 2) if that does not reduce tail latency within 20 minutes, we will roll back the recent kernel rollout in eu-west. I'll keep you posted with timestamps.

Sean
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

--
On Thu, Apr 1, 2027 at 08:40 Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com> wrote:
> Incident created: INC-20270401-EU-EMBED. Ops notified.
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T08:48:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Sudden p95 increase for embeddings (EU) — urgent

Connor / Sean — FYI, I pulled the live metrics and traces. Preliminary look: around 07:46 UTC we see an increased queuing time on the kernel-exec workers for embed-light-v1; the kernel rollout (commit c3f2a8) changed the routing tag matcher which caused a subset of requests to be routed to a VM pool with suboptimal KV cache warmup. That pool has higher cold-start token costs and elongated p95.

Attachments: incident-dump-20270401.log (truncated), kernel-rollout-metadata.json

Proposed quick steps:
- Flip routing tag to force Northwave to healthy pool (no schema change) — low-risk, immediate.
- If latency remains high, rollback commit c3f2a8 in eu-west and drain the affected pool.
- Postmortem to capture rollout checklist gap (routing matcher validation).

I can push a tag flip now; need ops approval to execute rollback if required.

Marissa
Sr. Prod Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-04-01T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sudden p95 increase for embeddings (EU) — urgent

> Proposed quick steps:
> - Flip routing tag to force Northwave to healthy pool (no schema change) — low-risk, immediate.
> - If latency remains high, rollback commit c3f2a8 in eu-west and drain the affected pool.

I've applied the routing override for northwave-account-id=NW-3245 at 08:58 UTC. Observability shows p95 dropping from ~1.1s to ~140ms for the sample requests within two minutes. We will keep the override in place while we validate for 60 minutes.

Rollback is staged but not executed. I'll monitor and escalate to full rollback if there's regression. Logging and a truncated incident dump attached.

Connor
Infra SRE | Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-04-01T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Sudden p95 increase for embeddings (EU) — mitigation applied

Elena — quick update: we've applied a targeted routing override for Northwave (NW-3245) in eu-west at 08:58 UTC which redirected your embed calls to a healthy pool. Early validation shows p95 for your sample requests dropped from ~1.1s to ~140ms. We will keep the override in place while we run a verification window (60 minutes).

What happened (short): a kernel rollout changed a routing matcher and caused a subset of embed requests to land on a pool with insufficient KV warmup. That increased tail latency for certain request shapes.

Next steps:
- We will perform a controlled rollback of the kernel commit in eu-west tonight at 02:00 UTC if no other regressions are found.
- Postmortem and follow-up doc will be published to the Drive link below by EOD Apr 3 with remediation actions and a checklist update.

Status links: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2027-eu-embed-routing
Postmortem (draft): https://drive.redwood.com/open?id=1a2b3c-postmortem-northwave

Apologies for the disruption — I'm available on this thread and by phone if you'd prefer a quick sync.

Sean Gallagher
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@northwave.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, support@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-03T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-incident update and postmortem link — EU embedding degradation

Elena — following up with the postmortem and remediation summary: we've published the investigation and the actions we took. Key points:

- Impact window: 2027-04-01T07:46:00Z to 2027-04-01T08:58:00Z for affected routing pool.
- Root cause: kernel rollout (commit c3f2a8) introduced a routing tag matcher change that placed some embed-light-v1 traffic on a pool with cold KV caches.
- Mitigation: targeted routing override at 08:58 UTC restored normal p95 for your requests; rollback of the commit in eu-west was completed at 02:15 UTC on Apr 2 as a precaution during our night maintenance window.
- Remediation actions: add pre-rollout matcher tests to CI, add guaranteed KV-warmup step for new pools, enhance canary traffic to include typical embed shapes.

Postmortem (final): https://drive.redwood.com/open?id=1a2b3c-postmortem-northwave
Status incident: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2027-eu-embed-routing

If you'd like an internal run-through or to review the fix checklist with your engineering team, happy to schedule a short session. Thank you for the patience and the quick signal — that helped reduce impact.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

--
